Hero_Desc_Festa:
An artist who rejects anything that restricts her, like rules and regulations, and sings of freedom.
She calls herself a 'champion of freedom'... but she is nothing more than a homeless person at a monorail station.
It's questionable as to whether or not she even truly knows the meaning of freedom.
Album_Hate_Festa: Rules and control. Her album that's called masterpiece by the public and society.
Album_Wish_Festa: Living in someone else's anarchist society.
Album_Festa1: An elf who calls herself a free spirit, she is under the strange illusion that everything around her is oppressing her. Liberating herself from these perceived restraints is her ultimate goal.
Album_Festa2: Festa's obsession with freedom closely matches Tig's paranoia. Perhaps that's why they get along so well, although there are times Festa appears to envy the lives of the werebeasts.
Album_Festa3: Festa's guitar is custom-made. They say there's only one of this precious thing in the world... Although, it would be nice if her playing skills were as great as her pride. Listening to howling werebeasts is better than listening to Festa's performance.
Album_Festa4: In fact, there are rumors that Festa's playing skills are topnotch. When I asked her to perform as she normally would, she coolly declined the request, saying the term 'normal' is systemically confining.
Album_Festa5: I tried to match Festa's personality, going along with her during our conversation, to which she responded that my agreement alone was enough to create an entire system. On top of that, I had to endure four more hours of her proselytizing her bizarre logic to me.
Album_Festa6: I asked Festa what she could to do to become happy, given her constant dissatisfaction with everything. She replied that happiness is an unattainable goal; living under such an illusion is the inevitable curse of the intelligent. Umm... I wasn't sure how to respond, so I kept listening to her preaching.
Album_Festa7: Festa is far too stylish and well-groomed for a mere street musician. Feeling suspicious, I secretly asked Rohne, an elven spy, to investigate. Turns out, Festa was actually a famous elven singer who had released numerous legendary albums under a different name. When I confronted her with the truth, she was visibly shaken, yelling that it is her destiny to live with such hypocrisy.
LoveHero_Festa:
If it's about busking, I'll go anywhere! Just a sec, let me grab my
can of coins...
LoveHeroCancel_Festa:
Is this the end of where the guerrilla concert ends?
That's a shame.
Food_ChefNote_Festa_Hate1: As soon as she saw the dish, Festa preached until the cows came home about how it was a mass-produced food created by an evil society.
Food_ChefNote_Festa_Hate2: It seems Festa watched a movie where canned food was involved. She shouted something incomprehensible and ran away.
Food_ChefNote_Festa_Like1: Festa started acting a little wild after drinking this. For some reason, she seems very excited.
Food_ChefNote_Festa_Like2: Festa praised this dish as philosophical, saying its fancy exterior but empty interior was a very good reflection of modern society.
Food_ChefNote_Festa_Like3: I looked away for a moment, but Festa kept sneezing and gave me a thumbs up. Did the powder get into her nose?
Food_ChefNote_Festa_Like4: She whined, asking why she couldn't set up a food stall and sell these at the Monatium monorail station.
Food_ChefNote_Festa_Like5: She said it reminded her of iced tea she had once tasted and drank it mixed with cold water.
Food_ChefNote_Festa_Like6: Festa praised it for being a cool idea, but seemed a bit disappointed upon hearing it was a well-known recipe.
Food_ChefNote_Festa_Like7: Festa says she wouldn't refuse food filled with the spirit of the New Year. She then enjoys it with excitement.
Food_ChefNote_Festa_Like8: Festa mentioned that it tastes both sweet and bitter. She enjoyed how it reminded her of life's sweet and bitter moments.
Food_ChefNote_Festa_Like9: Festa started an impromptu performance after eating the candy. Though. the lyrics seemed unrelated to the candy...

LoveLetter_Festa: [Hi there! This is the Rockfest Operations Manager. Congratulations! You've won two Rockfest tickets through the "Like Rockfest ElfTube and Join the Fun!" event.]Boom! My luck's pretty rockin', right? Since I'm performing, I don't need these tickets, but you'll want them! You're coming to see me bring the house down, right?! Catch ya there!
LoveCall_Festa:
Master! Are you busy?!
What is this about? Heh... Do not be surprised. I have an incredible proposal for you.
I am holding a guerrilla concert, and you should join me onstage!

Hmm? Why a concert out of nowhere? Master, the more sudden a concert is, the better.
The spirit of freedom always bursts into flame without warning!
What is your role? Vocals, obviously! What do you say? Will you do it?!
Do not worry~ I will coach you properly. Ahem, aaaaaah~!
W-What? You will find some other people for me? Urgh...!
No! This concert has to be just you and me!
Anyone else would only add more discord!
A-Anyway! We need to prepare together, so come to Monatium.
The two of us will put on the greatest performance!
Affinity_Festa_EP01_001: I've never seen such a quiet banquet hall in my life! It's so dull!
Affinity_Festa_EP01_004: Ask her to play something exciting.
Affinity_Festa_EP01_005: Strap in for one killer tune!
Affinity_Festa_EP01_006: Confiscate her guitar before she screws around with it.

Affinity_Festa_EP03_003: What if that system was built on a rebellious spirit? Can you rebel against rebellion?

Affinity_Festa_EP03_006: You just need to start by smashing things.
Affinity_Festa_EP03_007: Yeah! Things like this shouldn't be overanalyzed!
Affinity_Festa_EP04_001: Sigh... I was a celebrity in my hometown... but I don't get any recognition here in this backwater land.
Affinity_Festa_EP04_002: Yeah. I like food. What food do you like?
Affinity_Festa_EP04_003:
Nope, I was just a bum!
I was the "Slacker Girl" that showed up in the 5,210th episode of "Beyond Elves: Fact or Fiction"!
Affinity_Festa_EP04_004: I see you're the same as the other elves... You miss your home planet, huh?

Affinity_Festa_EP05_001:
It's ironic.

Affinity_Festa_EP05_003: That's all? They must've rocked into my head 'cause they're badass, no?

Affinity_Festa_EP05_006: Still, they say perseverance never lets you down, don't they?
Affinity_Festa_EP05_007:
Tsk, tsk, think about it. It invites more opportunities for betrayal.
Don't be so naive. You'll just end up being more disappointed in yourself.

Affinity_Festa_EP07_007: Exactly! Art is like a sick harmony of various elements coming together!
